key_insight: Injecting prepared logical resource states enables addressable, parallel universal fault-tolerant operations in high-rate concatenated self-dual codes.
engineering_relevance: The architecture combines logical computation with error correction and could reduce resource-preparation spacetime costs relative to surface-code cultivation.
method: Flexibly concatenate small-distance, high-rate self-dual CSS codes.
Prepare CSS stabilizer resources using flag-at-origin and global magic states using concatenated cultivation.
Consume resources through Steane-QEC or Knill-QEC teleportation, requiring at most 12D_T resource states for an algorithm with T-depth D_T.
evidence_signal: Benchmarks of resource-state preparation for several two-level concatenations of H codes and the [[15,7,3]] Hamming code report at least a tenfold spacetime reduction for concatenated cultivation versus surface-code cultivation.
watch_item: The reported resource-preparation advantage does not by itself establish end-to-end hardware performance or implementation feasibility.
paper_title: Injection is all you need: parallel universal logic in high-rate concatenated self-dual codes
